meta.name: Leyla Ile Mecnun
meta.description: The film tells the story of Ali and Leyla's struggle to be together. Leyla and Ali, who are cousins, swear to love each other forever when they are children. However, when Ali's family moves to a different place, the two are forced to part ways. Years later, their paths cross again. The two young people want to get married. However, the conflict between their families and Hamza's plans to marry Leyla stand in the way of their marriage. Nevertheless, the obstacles they face will not deter the two young people.
